sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Brick War is its unique brick-moving gameplay mechanic. The game takes place on a grid, where you'll compete with other characters to move bricks and transport them back to your territory. The game is won by collecting and transporting the most bricks, with each brick granting you points and rewards. The game's controls are simple yet intuitive, allowing you to drag and drop characters to move them around the grid.

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new characters, each with their unique abilities and strengths. Some characters are better suited for moving heavy bricks, while others excel at navigating tight spaces. This adds a layer of strategy to the game, as you'll need to choose the right character for the task at hand.

One of the standout features of Brick War's gameplay mechanics is its ability to adapt to your playing style. The game adjusts its difficulty level based on your performance, ensuring that you're always challenged but never overwhelmed. This makes the game perfect for players of all skill levels, from casual gamers to experienced players.
